🦸 Blend in and climb to the top,
😈 Or troll others by slapping and tricking them!

Transform into walls, camouflage to stay hidden, and sneak your way to victory. Will you escape the tower—or get caught trolling? in 💀 Hide or Die Tower!

🎯 Find All 35 Hidden Hiders!
Explore the classic Roblox Crossroads map and search every corner to discover all 35 scattered Hiders! 🕵️‍♂️👀
🏰 Discover Secret Areas!
Explore hidden parts of the tower and uncover new slap tools waiting to be found! 🔑✨
✋ Troll with your slap hand
🏆 Outsmart and out-hide everyone to be the ULTIMATE troll master!

Like 👍 and join the group for exclusive Fast Slap ⚡
